title: Canadian Solar Second Quarter 2026 Results
excerpt: Q2 revenue was USD 1.2 billion, gross margin was 13.9%, and operating cash flow was negative USD 181 million.
summary: The freshly retrieved Q2 release matches its retained hash. Canadian Solar reported module shipments of 3.1 GW, down 60% year over year, storage shipments of 3.7 GWh, up 73%, revenue of USD 1.2 billion and normalized gross margin of 13.9%. The attributable net loss was USD 77 million, operating cash use was USD 181 million, total debt was USD 7.1 billion, and planned Recurrent Energy project sales moved to the second half. Storage execution supports the thesis, but module economics, cash conversion, leverage and project-sale timing remain material risks.
